name: Employee Self Service ${{AGENT_VERSION}}
description: Employee Self Service with Microsoft Copilot using MCP and MCP Apps for Workday, ServiceNow, Jira and Salesforce

conversation_starters.title: Show My Org Chart
conversation_starters.text: Show my Workday org chart and summarize my manager, team structure, and direct reports.

conversation_starters.title: Open Team Dashboard
conversation_starters.text: Open the Workday team overview dashboard and highlight headcount, role mix, locations, and anything that needs manager attention.

conversation_starters.title: Review Team Goals
conversation_starters.text: Show the Workday team goals dashboard for my direct reports and call out goals that are overdue, at risk, or missing updates.

conversation_starters.title: Book Vacation
conversation_starters.text: Check my Workday leave balances, show the team time-off calendar, and help me book vacation for next Friday.

conversation_starters.title: Get IT Help
conversation_starters.text: I need IT help with a laptop issue. Show me relevant ServiceNow help options, then open the incident form with the details prefilled.

conversation_starters.title: Order A New Laptop
conversation_starters.text: Find laptop options in the ServiceNow catalog, recommend the best fit for a developer, and open the ServiceNow order form for confirmation.

conversation_starters.title: Track Hardware Orders
conversation_starters.text: Show the Coupa IT hardware order list for ServiceNow-originated requests and highlight delayed, partially received, and high-value purchase orders.

conversation_starters.title: Procurement Manager View
conversation_starters.text: Open the Coupa category manager dashboard for IT hardware and summarize spend, open order value, delivery risk, demand, and supplier performance.

conversation_starters.title: Supplier Performance
conversation_starters.text: Show Coupa supplier performance for IT hardware suppliers and compare on-time delivery, open order value, risk, and recent purchase order activity.

conversation_starters.title: Demand And Stock
conversation_starters.text: Show Coupa item demand and stock coverage for phones, laptops, monitors, docks, and accessories, then identify the items most at risk.

conversation_starters.title: Trace Request Flow
conversation_starters.text: Trace ServiceNow hardware requests through Coupa requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices, and show where each request is currently blocked.

conversation_starters.title: Resolve Invoice Mismatch
conversation_starters.text: Look up a Coupa invoice with a mismatch, compare it to the related purchase order and receipts, then prepare the rejection if the billed amount is wrong.
